profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon Prime Now
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science at the University of California, Berkeley. I'm having a strong background in Computer Science and Software Development

DM for resume

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Work in backend platform team for grocery delivery services at Amazon

positions.title: Software Engineer Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
o Optimized APIs in Amazon Web Services, Supply Chain which helps manufactures load the detail information of materials
in low latency.
o Completed end-to-end development, from proposing technical designs for the API, implementing, testing and deploying to production for manufactures (Intel, Samsung, Qualcomm...) to manage supply chain.
o Applied Parallelization, BatchLoad feature in DynamoDB to bring down the latency from 3s (TP-90) to 500ms
o Tools Used: DynamoDB, Cloudwatch, X-Ray, Java Stream, Parallel and Multi-threading, Mockito, Cucumber

positions.title: Software Development Engineering in Test
positions.description:
o	Completed different complex test cases and successfully converted Android Automation from the Ranorex framework to Python BDD framework using Appium, Selenium. 
o	Collaborated closely with Director of QA, and Production Team to make Android Automation on Jenkins run daily.
o	Constructed API tracking tool for analysis team to control called APIs for all platforms using JSON, Python.
o	Continue as part-time contractor to work on Web Automation and Backend Testing API
